rows.label: Picture shape
rows.help: 16:9 is real widescreen: the game draws a wider view. A change applies from the game's next start (a save state keeps the view it was saved with); until then the window keeps the shape the game draws. Stretch fills the window with the picture.

rows.label: Start in full screen
rows.help: F11 or Alt+Enter switches while you play.

rows.label: Window size
rows.help: In pixels, when the game starts in a window.

rows.label: Frame rate
rows.help: 60 is the original. From 120 the whole game runs that many frames a second: smoother, same speed, more work for the processor.

rows.label: Vertical sync
rows.help: Waits for the monitor: no tearing.

rows.label: Display limit
rows.help: The most frames a second the window shows. 0: no limit.

rows.label: Frame counter
rows.help: Frames a second, in the window's corner.

rows.label: Button prompts
rows.help: The buttons the game shows. Auto: those of the gamepad or keyboard you used last.

rows.label: Stick dead zone
rows.help: How far a stick moves before it counts.

rows.label: Extra mappings file
rows.help: A gamecontrollerdb.txt for a pad the game does not recognise. Usually empty.

rows.label: High resolution
rows.help: Twice the PS2's resolution with 4 or 8 samples, four times with 16.

rows.label: Samples per pixel
rows.help: More samples: smoother edges, more work for the graphics card.

rows.label: FXAA
rows.help: Smooths the edges of the finished picture.

rows.label: Smooth HUD
rows.help: The race display and the menu art smooth instead of blocky in high resolution.

rows.label: Car lights
rows.help: Brighter headlight and tail light glows: oncoming traffic shows from further away. 100% is the original.

rows.label: Progressive scan
rows.help: Whole frames instead of interlaced fields: no combed lines.

rows.label: Smooth enlargement
rows.help: Off: sharp pixels.

rows.label: Graphics on a second core
rows.help: The PS2's graphics units run on a processor core of their own.

rows.label: Fast loading
rows.help: Loading screens run faster than real time.

rows.label: Keep the game's speed
rows.help: When the graphics cannot keep up, the game draws fewer frames instead of slowing down.
